name: Amy De Bhrún
bio: Amy De Bhrún was born on 22 April 1984. She is an actress and writer, known for Jason Bourne (2016), Line of Duty (2012) and Borderline (2024).

credits.title: Wind of Change
credits.overview: A music biopic chronicling the incredible journey of the legendary rock group the Scorpion.

credits.title: Victorian Psycho
credits.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

credits.title: Small Things Like These
credits.overview: In 1985, while working as a coal merchant to support his family, Bill Furlong discovers disturbing secrets kept by the local convent and uncovers truths of his own; forcing him to confront his past and the complicit silence of a small Irish town controlled by the Catholic Church.

credits.title: Double Blind
credits.overview: After an experimental drug trial goes awry, the test subjects face a terrifying side effect: if you fall asleep you die. Trapped in an isolated facility, panic ensues as they try to escape and somehow stay awake.

credits.title: Callan Kicks The Year 2023
credits.overview: The annual comedy review starring Oliver Callan looks back on the year Ireland flipped out over RTÉ scandals and flopped out of a Rugby World Cup.

credits.title: Apocalypse Clown
credits.overview: When a mysterious technological blackout plunges Ireland into anarchy and chaos, a group of failed, washed-up clowns are forced to traverse the country for one last shot at their dreams.

credits.title: The Operator
credits.overview: During another dull day connecting long distance intergalactic calls from a remote satellite, Michael receives a distress call. No one ever receives a distress call. They barely touch on distress calls during the induction day.

credits.title: Conni and the Cat
credits.overview: Conni's adorable but mischievous cat Mau follows her on her kindergarten trip, causing mayhem, confusion and laughs. The children are kept busy hiding Mau from the teachers, tracking down a thief and saving a raccoon in an ancient castle.

credits.title: End of Sentence
credits.overview: Newly widowed Frank Fogle embarks on a journey to Ireland to scatter his late wife’s ashes. His estranged son, Sean, recently released from prison, agrees to join only when his father promises that they’ll never see each other again following the trip. credits.title: The Cured
credits.overview: What happens when the undead return to life? In a world ravaged for years by a virus that turns the infected into zombie-like cannibals, a cure is at last found and the wrenching process of reintegrating the survivors back into society begins.

credits.title: Jason Bourne
credits.overview: The most dangerous former operative of the CIA is drawn out of hiding to uncover hidden truths about his past.

credits.title: Gridlock
credits.overview: Gridlock is a thriller set during a traffic jam on a country road. When a little girl goes missing from one of the cars, her father forms a desperate search party to find her, and soon everyone is a suspect.

credits.title: The Stag
credits.overview: At his fiancée’s urging, a very modern Irish groom-to-be reluctantly agrees to a stag weekend with his friends, camping in the western wilderness of Ireland. credits.title: Jimi: All Is by My Side
credits.overview: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

credits.title: The Crown and the Dragon
credits.overview: In a war-torn country that is plagued by a vicious dragon, Elenn, an arrogant, young noblewoman, accompanies her aunt on a mission to bring an ancient relic to the secret coronation of the rightful king.
